# Typed by hand like the nickname file is: a country name is culture,
# not data — the engine never reads this, and nothing derives from it.
# The prefix is the part of a league code before the dash; codes with no
# The flag is the emoji the menu prints in front of the country. England
# and Scotland get their subdivision flags rather than one shared 🇬🇧,
# because the menu lists both and a shared flag would make two rows look
# like the same country. UEFA competitions fly the European flag; the
# continental cups that are nobody's league fly a globe.
